description.name: Entry
description.text: Fifteen single attacks (0.60 each), grants [Awoken Rogue], [Damage Cap +10000], [Twin Element Mode (Wind, Poison)], [Quick Cast 2] and [Stealthy Prowl Follow-Up] to the user

description.name: Awoken Rogue
description.text: Thief and Celerity abilities don't consume uses and deal 5/10/15/20/30% more damage at ability rank 1/2/3/4/5, Thief and Celerity abilities trigger 1 additional time

description.name: Twin Element Mode (Wind, Poison)
description.text: Grants [Attach Wind]/[Attach Poison] after using a Wind/Poison ability

description.name: Attach Wind
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Wind damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Wind resistance +20%

description.name: Attach Poison
description.text: Replaces Attack command, increases Poison damage dealt by 50/80/120% (abilities) or 80/100/120% (Soul Breaks), Poison resistance +20%

description.name: Stealthy Prowl Follow-Up
description.text: Casts Stealthy Prowl after using two Thief or Celerity abilities

description.name: Stealthy Prowl
description.text: Eight single attacks (0.50 each) if the user has Haste (100% hit rate if triggered), grants [Quick Cast 2] to all allies in the character's row
